snippet.title: ITER-8 Release Date Trailer
snippet.description:
Get ready, Operator #8! The wait is over. ITER-8 is launching on Steam on March 9th!

Drill into colossal Pillars, mine essential resources, defend your base with turrets, and upgrade your gear, all while surviving the chaos of the surface. Every iteration counts… but don’t get too attached.

💥 Key Features:
- Vertical mining madness, climb, drill, and conquer the Pillars
- Strategic base defense, build turrets and survive waves of threats
- Upgrade your tools & abilities, mine faster, shoot harder, last longer
- Darkly comedic corporate satire, your life is expendable, your replacements are inevitable

Play the free demo now on Steam:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/3936690/ITER8_Demo/
